fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
    OR(
        Risk_Rating__c = "Phase 1",
        Risk_Rating__c = "Phase 2"
    ) &&
    (
        ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Positive") ||
        ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Assumed Positive") ||
        ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Negative - Treated as Positive")
    ),
    "1. High risk ACMs",

    IF(
        AND(
            Risk_Rating__c = "Phase 3",
            ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Positive") ||
            ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Assumed Positive") ||
            ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Negative - Treated as Positive")
        ),
        "2. Moderate risk ACMs",

        IF(
            OR(
                Risk_Rating__c = "Phase 4",
                Risk_Rating__c = "Phase 5"
            ) &&
            (
                ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Positive") ||
                ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Assumed Positive") ||
                ISPICKVAL(Sample_Analysis_Result_Material_Status__c, "Negative - Treated as Positive")
            ),
            "3. Lower risk ACMs",
            NULL
        )
    )
)

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
        VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) < Minimum_Estimated_Product_Life__c ,
        'Less than Minimum',
        IF(
            VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) = Minimum_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
            'Minimum',
            IF(
               VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) < Average_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
                'Minimum to Average',
                IF(
                    VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) = Average_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
                    'Average',
                    IF(
                        VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) < Maximum_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
                        'Average to Max',
                        IF(
                            VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) = Maximum_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
                            'Max',
                IF(
                   VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(Building_Code__r.Estimated_Age__c, ' Years', '')) > Maximum_Estimated_Product_Life__c,
                            'Greater than Max',
                            ''
                        )

                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)
